title: The Secret Investigation
description: Plot: Begin systematic investigation, discover first real clues | Emotion: Excitement of discovery mixed with growing concern about what they're finding | Setting: Various academy locations - Crystal Chamber, corridors, hidden passages at That afternoon, during regular class periods | Characters: Princess Luna, Princess Ruby, Princess Sage, Stardust, Blaze, Whisper
lyrics:
I never thought I'd be the one
To lead an investigation
But when I see what others miss
It fills me with elation

My starlight shows the hidden truth
That lies beneath the surface
And with my friends beside me here
I know we'll find our purpose

I used to think that being perfect
Meant doing everything alone
But now I see that real strength comes
From seeds that we have sown

Together we're much stronger than
We ever were apart
When everyone contributes their gift
We're following our heart

All the books I've ever read
Are coming alive today
When knowledge meets with courage
We can find another way

The past can teach the present
If we're willing to explore
And mysteries that seemed impossible
Don't seem so hard anymore

We can figure this out
We can solve this mystery
We can figure this out
When we work together, we're free

Every clue that we discover
Every piece that fits in place
Shows us that we're stronger
When we're working face to face

We can figure this out
We can figure this out
Together, we can figure this out

STARDUST:
In the starlight, truth appears

BLAZE:
In the fire, courage grows

WHISPER:
In the memory, wisdom flows

ALL UNICORNS:
And together, our magic shows

That friendship is the strongest spell
That love can conquer fear
When hearts and minds work as one
The answer becomes clear

ALL:
We can figure this out
We can solve this mystery
We can figure this out
When we work together, we're free

Every friendship that we're building
Every trust that we create
Shows us that together
We can change our academy's fate

We can figure this out
We can figure this out
Together, we can figure this out

(Building to climax)
No mystery's too big for us
No challenge we can't face
When we combine our different gifts
We'll solve this case!
stage_directions: Character Development. The scene moves fluidly between multiple academy locations as the investigation unfolds. The Crystal Chamber remains eerily empty, corridors seem longer and more shadowy than usual, and hidden passages behind tapestries and portraits are revealed for the first time.. The academy feels different during this investigation - more mysterious, with magic that responds to the girls' determination and curiosity. Secret doors open to their touch, and hidden details become visible when they work together.
